summary: Iter617: Accounting Connectors (Xero/QBO/e-Fatura), Job Queue, Tenant SSO, Organizations & property-scoped RBAC tested end-to-end. 15/16 backend tests passed; only failure is PUT /api/orgs/users/{user_id}/property-roles returning 404 because users collection is keyed by Mongo _id (ObjectId hex) but tenant_sso.py updates by field 'id'. Frontend fully functional: SSO buttons disabled with not-configured text; login?sso=error&reason=no_org_for_domain shows Turkish toast; AdminPanel → Team Members shows OrganizationsCard with 'HotelBox Group … 2 tesis'; org creation toast 'Organizasyon oluşturuldu' works and new row appears; System Health → JobQueueCard shows counters (done 2, failed 1) and retry works (toast 'Yeniden kuyruğa alındı'); Reports & Analytics → Accounting export shows AccountingConnectorsCard, connect-xero/qbo DISABLED, preview shows block, run shows toast with 'Yevmiye/Xero/mock', efatura toggle works.

critical.issue: Returns 404 'User not found' for every user because users collection stores primary key as MongoDB _id (ObjectId), but the handler queries db.users.update_one({'id': user_id}, ...). Same user_id returned by /api/users list. Fix: either query by _id (ObjectId(user_id)) or ensure users have an 'id' string field mirroring _id.

action_items: Fix property-roles handler in /app/backend/routes/security/tenant_sso.py to match user_id against ObjectId(_id) since users collection uses Mongo _id (not string 'id').
critical_code_review_comments: tenant_sso.py assign() and set_property_roles() use {'id': user_id} but /api/users endpoint returns str(_id) as 'id' — inconsistent identifier strategy will break Org→User assignments in production.
sso_callback verify_iss uses bool(provider=='google' or MS_SSO_TENANT_ID) — when Microsoft tenant not set, issuer verification is skipped even though token is still trusted; consider hardening.
accounting_sync.py push_journal returns dict containing possibly injected _id via insert_one dict copy — mitigated by rec.pop('_id', None), but be cautious.
e-Fatura invoice numbering uses count_documents+1 → not race-safe under concurrent daily runs; consider atomic counter.

rca of the issue: PUT /api/orgs/users/{user_id}/property-roles returns 404. RCA: /api/users list endpoint returns each user's Mongo ObjectId converted to hex string as 'id' (e.g. 69d94ce991623ac1e12675b3). However tenant_sso.py's set_property_roles does db.users.update_one({'id': user_id}, ...) — the users collection does not have a top-level 'id' field, only _id. Fix: `from bson import ObjectId; await db.users.update_one({'_id': ObjectId(user_id)}, ...)` (with try/except for invalid ObjectId → 404). Same issue in POST /api/orgs/{id}/assign for user_ids array.
